result: A swan is exactly right. The Silver Swan is our oldest and proudest trophy, so having it on the clubhouse wall feels fitting. The sketch has the sweep of the neck I was hoping for, but right now the whole thing reads a bit like a crescent or a banana, and the neck looks stiff and angular where I want it to feel elegant. I'd also like the head and beak to be easier to pick out, because at the moment I have to squint to see them.
